name: BACH_0301_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 blurred simulated frozen section suggests invasive carcinoma [F1] with positive margins on all four edges [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strongly favors invasive carcinoma |
| Conformal set | Invasive (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Unflagged despite blur; extreme OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%), 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Neighbors support invasive; InSitu runner-up |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.42), +0.84 impact, 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 10) · context · Low (-0.04), +0.53 impact, 8/20 spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (0.06), +0.39 impact, 20/20 spot check [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · High (1.35), +0.38 impact, 0/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; top-3 risk deletion drops invasive probability beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules and mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur and 100th-percentile OOD status obscure intact ductal borders of in situ carcinoma (BACH_0253).
- Reliability scoring misses some misclassified frozen sections (70% error AUROC), and cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 9**: Confirm stromal invasion versus blurred in situ carcinoma in peak-risk tiles (99%–100% risk).
2. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Check benign stroma (region 11, 0% risk) and features distinguishing InSitu BACH_0253.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify tumor at superior (323 um), medial/inferior (215 um), and lateral (108 um) margins.
